incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A scene of extensive structural damage to buildings, with rubble and debris scattered across the ground. Partially intact buildings are visible in the foreground and background, with a tree and distant hills in the background.

observations.description: A multi-story building is heavily collapsed with exposed interiors and debris. Adjacent structure has collapsed roof and damaged walls.
A tall pole stands near the rubble pile. Other buildings are visible in the background, some intact, some damaged.
A green tree is visible behind the rubble pile. Some bushes and greenery are scattered around the debris.
A large white sack is sitting on a concrete base near the left edge, near a partially intact building with green paint.
